summary: BioMar Chile adjusts its working practices to manage challenges posed by the COVID-19 pandemic. The article covers operational adaptations made by the aquaculture feed company during the health crisis period in April 2020.
title: BioMar Chile ajusta su forma de trabajar ante la pandemia
title_en: BioMar Chile ajusta su forma de trabajar ante la pandemia

summary: BioMar's new aquaculture feed facility in Tasmania has its IT infrastructure managed remotely from a basement location in northern Norway. The article highlights an unconventional operational setup for managing critical systems at the new production site.
title: IT-systemene til BioMars nye fabrikk på Tasmania driftes fra en kjellerstue i nord
